rules: Curriculum reference is England, not a claim of one UK-wide national curriculum.
Year labels are navigation aids; prerequisites and learner goals guide placement.
KS3/KS4/KS5 year allocations are proposed planning, not DfE-prescribed annual sequences.
Year 4 small-step documents are the 2017–18 edition, not assumed to be the latest White Rose scheme.
Ready-to-progress criteria support prioritisation but are not the whole primary curriculum.
Essential understanding, optional depth and exam-specific requirements must remain distinct.
No full White Rose schemes or worksheets are redistributed with this package.
